title: The continuity properties of the solutions of the wave equation at different boundary conditions across the characteristic line
summary: It is well-known the continuity properties of solutions to the wave equation depend strongly on both the initial data and the boundary conditions, particularly across the characteristic lines, where information propagates. Moreover, the continuity properties of solutions to the wave equation depend strongly on the type of boundary condition imposed and on the interaction of the characteristics with the boundary.
